content.text:
I've submitted index 15 (La 0.67 / Sb 0.33) as the best composition. Its EQE was only 0.0025%, and it was the only one of the three measurements that came out above zero. Every composition I measured is a very weak photoanode, and 26 of the 29 were never measured, so a better one may still be in the library.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) | Why I measured it |
|---|---|---|---|
| 25 | 0.62 | −0.0009 | Near La3Sb5O12, which is predicted stable with a 2.26 eV gap, below the 3.2 eV photon energy |
| 15 | 0.33 | **0.0025** | Near La2SbO6, predicted gap 2.6 eV but slightly unstable (0.085 eV/atom above the hull) |
| 11 | 0.23 | −0.0003 | The Gaussian-process model's suggestion |

- **The model predictions didn't hold up.** The stable, absorbing phase at index 25 gave nothing. That doesn't match the phase and band-gap predictions, and I can't explain why.
- **Index 11 went against the models' warning.** The known phase near that composition, La3SbO7, is stable but has a 4.3 eV gap, too wide to absorb the 3.2 eV light. I measured it anyway because EQE had been rising toward the La-rich side, and it came out at about zero.
- **XRD:** I used 2 of the 5 scans, at indices 15 and 25. Both patterns were mostly weak features next to what look like substrate peaks, so I couldn't confirm which phases the films actually contain.
